name: Uptime
author: E. T. Carter
description: A low eye in the cold aisle of a data hall: steel racks recede on both sides into blue haze, packed with servers, drive bays and blanking panels and pricked with thousands of cyan, white and a few amber status lights, mirrored in the polished floor tiles under hanging cable trays and a line of ceiling strips. A broad band of cold light slowly sweeps away down the aisle, washing the rack fronts and floor as it passes, while the eye drifts forward and the lights blink.

params.label: Scan light
params.effect: Brightness of the band of cold light scanning down the aisle.

params.label: Scan speed
params.effect: How fast the scan band travels away down the aisle.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: Density of the cold haze that swallows the far end of the hall.

params.label: Activity
params.effect: How many status lights are lit and how fast they blink.
